_comment: Alarm V1 — every tunable lives here. Nothing in the code hardcodes a threshold, a colour or a path. Changing category/paths should be enough to run this for another product group or another company.
as_of_note_ro: Stoc depozit la IUNIE 2026 (export cu COD ARTICOL). Magazinele: fiecare cu ultima poziție raportată — 4 magazine la iunie 2026, Constanța/Iași/Oradea încă la decembrie 2025. Datele exacte pe fiecare strat sunt în Verificare.
as_of_note_en: Importer stock at JUNE 2026 (code-keyed export). Stores: each contributes its last reported position — 4 stores at June 2026, Constanța/Iași/Oradea still at December 2025. Exact per-layer dates are on the Check page.

velocity._comment: blended monthly rate = w*short_window_rate + (1-w)*long_window_rate; recency-leaning but not jumpy

replenishment.default_lead_time_source: ASSUMED — no factory lead times received yet
replenishment.review_period_source: ASSUMED — import ordering cadence roughly quarterly per zone
replenishment._comment: SS = z * sigma_monthly * sqrt(LT_months + review_months); ROP = rate*LT + SS; target = rate*(LT+review) + SS

taxonomy._comment: Tibi's 5 colours stay the top level. Each colour that hides two different decisions is split into a sub-state — this is the '8 quadrants' he asked about.

money.basis_note_ro: Valoarea stocului = cost de achiziție (VALOARE STOC / STOC din exportul depozitului). Este banul blocat, nu cifra de afaceri potențială.
money.basis_note_en: Stock value = acquisition cost (VALOARE STOC / STOC from the warehouse export). This is capital tied up, not potential revenue.
money.cost_fallback_note: ASSUMED — where no warehouse cost exists, cost = 55% of realised average selling price

export._comment: Tibi's real workflow: export, multiply every line by one factor to hit factory minimums. The export ships with that factor as a live Excel formula.

ui.focus_family_note: Scope discipline (brief §6): validate one gamă end-to-end before widening.

rug_inclusion._comment: Which importer-stock buckets count as rugs. Codes already present in the sales-derived rug universe are always included. These buckets cover codes that appear ONLY in warehouse stock and have never sold — without them, never-sold dead stock is invisible, which is the opposite of the tool's purpose.
rug_inclusion.exclusion_note: Bath mats, floor adhesive, fixing clips, price labels, broadloom/mocheta and stair treads are real INDOMEX stock but a different product family. Flip a bucket into include_name_buckets to bring it in.

producer._comment: Producer attribution. SUBCLASA (real data) always wins, then FURNIZOR EXT. Only if both are absent does prefix inference apply, and every inferred row is stamped INFERRED_from_code_prefix so it is never mistaken for source data.
producer.infer_note: A 3-letter SKU code prefix is used ONLY where it maps to exactly one producer among codes that carry a real SUBCLASA. Set infer_from_code_prefix=false to switch this off; those rows then read NEATRIBUIT.
